name: mobilenetv4-small-features.onnx
modification: Remove final ImageNet classifier; expose flattened pre-classifier embedding. No retraining or weight quantization.
preprocessing: sRGB, whole image aspect-fit 224x224 with mean RGB padding, bilinear interpolation; RGB/255, mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. Deliberately replaces upstream 256 resize + 224 center crop to retain screenshot edges. L2 normalize output.
